application: Keep the recurring original 3D cartoon characters and believable everyday German setting
Make the problem and relevant prop visible immediately; keep the speaker's face, hands and object readable
Use a medium action shot, a closer object-and-reaction shot and a visible payoff when the story needs them
Prefer one restrained, purposeful camera movement per shot; preserve the mouth and object in frame
Preserve consistent lighting, color, object ownership and screen direction across cuts
limits: A catalog entry is not evidence that a page, film frame or motion sample was fetched or watched
These are visual-design references, not factual authorities for German transport, laws or everyday rules
Reference availability does not grant permission to reuse film frames, clips or character designs
Do not download media, install integrations, subscribe or spend paid credits automatically
Retain exact episode duration, one-speaker audio-driven lip sync, caption safe areas and existing quality gates
